messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "taking certain oral diabetes medicines may increase risk of serious heart problems"
set: ["taking certain oral diabetes medicines may increase risk of serious heart problems", "serious heart problems when used with oral diabetes medicines", "may increase risk of muscle problems", "oral diabetes medicines", "this can increase the risk of serious muscle problems", "taking certain other medicines", "may increase risk of eclampsia", "increased risk of serious muscle problems when used with certain drugs", "people taking certain other medicines", "may increase risk of unintended pregnancy", "certain medicines", "may increase risk of complications in newborn", "may increase risk of low birth weight", "alcohol may increase risk of liver damage", "absorption of oral medicines", "breathing problems if combined with certain medicines"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
